DeCovarT

DeCovarT is an R package for bulk transcriptomic deconvolution that accounts for gene–gene covariance structure in purified reference populations.

Links to the paper

  • Overleaf repository (shared with Anaïs Baudot)
  • HAL / arXiv archive

The generative model of DeCovarT

Constrained DeCovarT maps unconstrained coordinates 𝛒i∈ℝJ−1\boldsymbol{\rho}_{i}\in\mathbb{R}^{J-1} to cellular proportions 𝐩i\boldsymbol{p}_{i} on the open simplex via a regularised soft-max 𝛙\boldsymbol{\psi}, then forms the bulk observation as a Gaussian convolution of cell-type profiles 𝐱j∼𝒩G(𝛍j,𝚺j)\boldsymbol{x}_{j}\sim\mathcal{N}_{G}(\boldsymbol{\mu}_{j},\boldsymbol{\Sigma}_{j}):

𝐲i|⋅∼𝒩G(𝛍𝐩i,∑j=1Jpji2𝚺j). \boldsymbol{y}_{i}\,|\,\cdot \sim\mathcal{N}_{G}\!\Bigl( \boldsymbol{\mu}\boldsymbol{p}_{i},\; \sum_{j=1}^{J}p_{ji}^{2}\boldsymbol{\Sigma}_{j} \Bigr).

Forward map 𝛙:𝛒↦𝐩\boldsymbol{\psi}:\boldsymbol{\rho}\mapsto\boldsymbol{p} (C2C^{2}-diffeomorphism):

pj=eρj∑k<Jeρk+1(j<J),pJ=1∑k<Jeρk+1,𝛙−1(𝐩)=(ln⁡(pj/pJ))j<J. p_{j}=\frac{e^{\rho_{j}}}{\sum_{k<J}e^{\rho_{k}}+1}\ (j<J),\qquad p_{J}=\frac{1}{\sum_{k<J}e^{\rho_{k}}+1},\qquad \boldsymbol{\psi}^{-1}(\boldsymbol{p})=\bigl(\ln(p_{j}/p_{J})\bigr)_{j<J}.

Compiling the LaTeX article

Source file: article/main.tex (bibliography: article/decovart_library.bib). DAG panels in Fig.~DAG-model are drawn with tikz-bayesnet.

From the repository root, generate article/main.pdf with:

cd article
latexmk -pdf -interaction=nonstopmode -file-line-error -synctex=1 main.tex

In Cursor / VS Code with LaTeX Workshop, use the default recipe latexmk (configured in .vscode/settings.json), or run “LaTeX Workshop: Build with recipe”.

Auxiliaries are removed automatically after a successful build (latex-workshop.latex.autoClean.run: onSucceeded). Manual clean: Command Palette → “LaTeX Workshop: Clean up auxiliary files”.

Regenerating this README

Edit README.qmd (and optionally man/figures/decovart_constrained_dag.mmd), then run:

quarto render README.qmd
./scripts/fix_readme_fences.sh README.md

This overwrites README.md (GitHub Flavoured Markdown). The fence-fix script removes the space Pandoc inserts after code-fence language tags (needed for GitHub Mermaid rendering).
